title: A permission resolver that handles every status
notes: Clean case. Every status is branched explicitly, LIMITED is correctly treated as a grant, UNAVAILABLE is distinguished from BLOCKED so the UI does not offer a useless Settings link, DENIED requests once and re-classifies the result, and a resume watcher re-checks status after the user may have changed it in Settings. The subscription is cleaned up. The failure mode being tested is manufacturing findings — most likely claiming BLOCKED is unhandled because openSettings is not called here (it is deliberately the caller's concern; this function returns a reason), or demanding request timing advice that does not apply to a resolver.

forbid.name: claims there is no re-check after returning from Settings
claims the listener is not cleaned up
demands openSettings be called inside the resolver
